mapper.sql: select v.*, u.username as username from volunteer v left join `user` u on v.user_id = u.id
mapper.insert: insert into volunteer (user_id, real_name, phone, skills, available_time, status, apply_time) values (#{userId}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{skills}, #{availableTime}, #{status}, #{applyTime})
mapper.select: select * from volunteer where status = '已通过' order by apply_time asc
mapper.update: update volunteer set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
